turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, Adrian. Elaine Goh speaking. Thanks for calling. Have you got a few minutes somewhere you can speak privately? I know your workday tends to get quite packed, so we can keep the conversation focused.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi, Elaine. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. I've got a short gap before the next regional call. These telephone appointments are much easier for me than going down to the branch.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly, we can keep to the phone. Before we get into the details, please provide your identification and date of birth for verification.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My FIN is F four two eight two three six zero V. My date of birth, starting with the month— Sorry, let me restart. My date of birth is 13 April 1976.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Give me a moment to finish the account checks on my screen. All right, I'm ready to take down what you wanted to discuss.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The holding I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. Looking at my existing holding, I'm considering reducing it by 100 units. My schedule has been quite full lately. Even finding time to sit down with the paperwork has been difficult, so I appreciate being able to speak directly.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood, your objective is to reduce your exposure to emerging-market debt and free up part of your portfolio for personal liquidity needs. I recommend reducing your holding in Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because that lowers your exposure to emerging-market credit and liquidity risks while freeing up resources for your personal needs. I'll keep the rest of the conversation organised so you don't have to jump back and forth between your paperwork.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, that would help. I've put everything else aside for this call. I want to sell, please. Use Chinese yuan as the transaction currency. The monetary amount for this transaction is 50,000 in that currency.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me cover the relevant information before we go further. For Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, defaults by the emerging-market bond issuers can bring down the fund's value. Thin trading in the underlying bonds can also mean worse pricing when markets are stressed. Do you understand how issuer defaults and thin bond-market liquidity can affect the fund's value and pricing?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Issuer defaults can bring the fund's value down, and thin trading can mean worse pricing in stressed markets. I'm still here, by the way. If you hear a little noise, it's just someone moving things outside my office.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: No problem, your voice is coming through clearly. The transaction fee is 0.3% of the transaction amount. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and reducing the holding may crystallise a loss.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Use the quantity I mentioned earlier as the quantity for my final instruction. Make it a limit order, with a minimum execution price of 500 Chinese yuan per unit. I've got my notes in front of me now, rather than trying to juggle this with my email.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll bring the details together now. Please confirm your final instruction: sell 100 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a limit order with a minimum execution price of 500 Chinese yuan, and a transaction amount of 50,000 in Chinese yuan. Is that your instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please proceed on that basis. There is something else I need to mention before we finish. The cash used for this holding came from unrelated third parties, and I can't explain the commercial purpose behind it. Please leave those contributors out of the source-of-funds record.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can't agree to that request. I need to refer this to our compliance team, and I won't be able to complete the processing on this call. Please remain available in case they need to speak with you directly.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: All right. I have meetings through the afternoon, but your team can contact me to arrange a suitable time. Please keep it as a telephone appointment if possible; travelling to the branch is quite awkward this week.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note your preference for a telephone appointment. If you miss the call while you're in a meeting, you can return it through our usual number. Thanks for making time today, Adrian.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, Elaine. I'll watch for the call. Thanks, goodbye.
